description: This file is a script that performs static analysis and inventory collection for a plugin extension import boundary check in a TypeScript-based project. It includes functions to scan source files, detect violations, compare inventories, and output reports. The script primarily operates on TypeScript files within a specific directory structure, and it references external utility modules and baseline JSON files.

methods.name: compareEntries
methods.description: Compares two inventory entries to determine their order based on file, line, kind, specifier, and reason.

methods.name: classifyResolvedExtensionReason
methods.description: Classifies the reason for an extension's resolved path, indicating whether it's an extension implementation, entrypoint, or owned file.

methods.name: pushEntry
methods.description: Adds an entry to the entries array.

methods.name: scanImportBoundaryViolations
methods.description: Scans a source file for import boundary violations related to plugin extension imports from a specific directory structure.

methods.name: scanWebSearchRegistrySmells
methods.description: Detects potential registry smell issues in the web-search-providers TypeScript file, based on specific patterns.

methods.name: shouldSkipFile
methods.description: Determines whether a file should be skipped based on its path.

methods.name: collectPluginExtensionImportBoundaryInventory
methods.description: Asynchronously collects an inventory of import boundary violations across relevant TypeScript files, with caching.

methods.name: readExpectedInventory
methods.description: Reads the baseline expected inventory JSON file with caching.

methods.name: diffInventory
methods.description: Computes differences between the expected and actual inventories.

methods.name: formatInventoryHuman
methods.description: Formats the inventory into a human-readable string report.

methods.name: formatEntry
methods.description: Formats a single inventory entry into a string.

methods.name: runPluginExtensionImportBoundaryCheck
methods.description: Runs the import boundary check, comparing actual and expected inventories, and outputs the result.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that orchestrates the boundary check and exits with the appropriate code.
